chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ṣafwān al-Jammāl, who said:

I, and ʿĀmir, and ʿAbdullāh ibn Judhāʿah al-Azdī were in the presence of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام. He said: Then ʿĀmir said to him, “May I be sacrificed for you, the people claim that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام was buried in al-Raḥbah.”

He عليه السلام said, “No.” He said, “Then where was he buried?” He عليه السلام said, “When he passed away, al-Ḥasan عليه السلام carried him and brought him to the back of al-Kūfah, near al-Najaf, to the left of al-Gharī, to the right of al-Ḥīrah, and buried him between white mounds.”

He said: Then later, I went to the location and supposed a particular place within it. Then I came to him and informed him, so he said to me, “You were correct. May Allah have mercy on you,” three times.

key_terms.أَصَبْتَ: you were correct; you identified it accurately
key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title referring here to Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام
key_terms.النَّجَفِ: Najaf, the region near the burial place mentioned in the report
key_terms.الْحِيرَةِ: al-Ḥīrah, another landmark marking the area
key_terms.الْغَرِيِّ: al-Gharī, a landmark used to identify the location
key_terms.رَكَوَاتٍ بِيضٍ: white mounds or elevated white patches of land

ai.seo_question: Where was Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام buried according to al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a report from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning the burial place of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. It identifies the grave as being near al-Najaf, behind al-Kūfah, and records the narrator’s later recognition of the site, which the Imam عليه السلام affirmed.
